newsitem.title: CANADA: Martin sees impact from GM Canada strike.
newsitem.headline: Martin sees impact from GM Canada strike.

text.p: Canada's Finance Minister Paul Martin said on Thursday that a long strike at General Motors Corp's Canadian unit would have "a market effect" on the Canadian economy.

"There's no doubt that a strike at GM that was to last a long time would have a marked effort on the Canadian economy. It's obviously of concern," Martin told reporters after a session of parliament. He said that "the federal government will assume its responsibilities," but referred further details to the labour minister. About 15,500 GM unionized workers in Ontario and Quebec went on strike late Wednesday.
Under the Canadian Auto Workers union's escalating strike strategy, all 26,000 GM Canada unionized workers would be on strike by October 9.
Analysts said a prolonged strike could seriously harm Canada's economic recovery, potentially shaving up to one percentage point off fourth-quarter growth.
